universityName: The University of Texas at Austin

officialLinks.label: GPA computation; grade values; undergraduate/graduate inclusion

helpIntro: UT Austin uses a 4.0 scale with plus/minus grades. Enter semester credit hours and final grades to estimate your undergraduate cumulative University GPA.
helpNote: For the standard undergraduate University GPA. Transfer grades do not enter the UT GPA, and every UT grade from a repeated course remains in the GPA. Law uses a separate 4.30 scale; graduate GPA inclusion rules differ.
helpExample: A 3-hour A earns 12.00 grade points; a 3-hour B+ earns 9.99. Together, 21.99 ÷ 6 = 3.665.

gradeExplanations.A: A = 4.00 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.A-: A- = 3.67 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.B+: B+ = 3.33 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.B: B = 3.00 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.B-: B- = 2.67 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.C+: C+ = 2.33 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.C: C = 2.00 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.C-: C- = 1.67 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.D+: D+ = 1.33 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.D: D = 1.00 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.D-: D- = 0.67 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.F: F = 0.00 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.X: Temporary delay of grade; excluded until replaced.
gradeExplanations.S: Satisfactory developmental-study symbol; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.U: Unsatisfactory developmental-study symbol; excluded from GPA.

specialTypes.name: UT Austin undergraduate course
specialTypes.note: Use final UT Austin letter grades and semester hours.

specialTypes.name: External transfer course
specialTypes.note: Grades earned outside UT Austin do not enter the cumulative University GPA.

specialTypes.name: UT Austin Law School course
specialTypes.note: Law uses a separate 4.30 grading scale; do not calculate it with the undergraduate scale.

specialTypes.name: Graduate record/course context
specialTypes.note: Graduate GPA inclusion rules differ; use the official graduate record rules.

repeatPolicy.note: Enter each graded attempt as a separate completed course. All attempts count in GPA; repeat-for-credit eligibility can vary by college/school.
